# A removed upstream transform can break taskgraph loading before any release task runs

The human bustage port removes the deleted Gecko release_flatpak_repackage transform import from the kind chain. Other transforms remain. At the fixed revision the kind names a comm transform instead; the original import removal does not mean Flatpak functionality was abandoned. Upstream transform internals and actual decision-task generation remain outside this patch audit. No release or taskgraph execution ran.

Scope: Taskgraph transform dependencies.
